name: Denoising using Non Local Means (NLM)
summary: Denoises a DWI series with the DIPY 1.1.1 non-local means (dipy_denoise_nlmeans) workflow and outputs the denoised DWI with its bvals and bvecs.
description: Wraps the DIPY 1.1.1 command-line workflow dipy_denoise_nlmeans. Use it as an optional early DWI preprocessing step to reduce noise before model fitting. It needs a DWI image with bvals/bvecs; the gradient files are copied unchanged to the output. Note that main always passes --rician, whatever the rician parameter says.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image (NIfTI) with its bvals and bvecs files.

outputs.description: Denoised DWI (dwi.nii.gz) with the original bvals and bvecs.

parameters.description: Sigma parameter to pass to the nlmeans algorithm
If True the noise is estimated as Rician, otherwise Gaussian noise is assumed.

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).
